boundary: Repository-owned public HTML routes, code owners, provider bindings, acceptance evidence, and explicit gaps. The current candidate build owns 44 HTML routes plus an explicit 404. Seventeen Japanese candidates (Portal, Twitch Home, Kick Home, Twitch Heatmap, Kick Heatmap, Twitch Day Flow, Kick Day Flow, Twitch Battle Lines, Kick Battle Lines, Twitch History, Kick History, Twitch Stream Map, Kick Stream Map, Twitch Data Status, Kick Data Status, Twitch Channel, Kick Channel) are noindex and excluded from sitemap/hreflang/public language switching until the coordinated Japanese release gate. Japanese Channel reuses the existing provider-separated History endpoints and Channel runtime; the locale adapter owns presentation and link localization only, preserves query-state URLs, and does not change retained-history semantics. Japanese Data Status and Stream Map continue to reuse their existing provider-separated runtimes and APIs without changing collector, storage, cadence, retention, geography/evidence, or Current/IRL semantics. Historical Phase 12/R12A acceptance evidence remains separately preserved.
